To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $80,$ and the percentage is $115%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
115%=115÷100=1.15
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =115%\times 80 \\  & =1.15\times 80 \\  & =92\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $115%$ of $80$ is $92.$

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
115%=\frac{115}{100}=\frac{115÷5}{100÷5}=\frac{23}{20}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =115%\times 80 \\  & =\frac{23}{20}\times 80 \\  & =23\times \frac{80}{20} \\  & =23\times 4 \\  & =92\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $115%$ of $80$ is $92.$
